name: @nadir/python
description: Turbo facade over the native Python SDK

scripts.build: cargo run --quiet --package xtask -- native python build --out dist/pypi
scripts.typecheck: echo 'Python API is runtime-checked at the native transport boundary'
scripts.lint: cd ../.. && ruff check python/nadir && ruff format --check python/nadir
scripts.fmt: cd ../.. && ruff check --fix python/nadir && ruff format python/nadir
scripts.advisories: echo 'Python native dependencies are audited through Cargo.lock'
